name: Hand ASM
compiler:
Apple clang version 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.4)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin24.1.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin

changes.change: Use scaled halfword table addressing; remove redundant match-loop subtraction; hoist invariant vector moves from long-copy emission.
Read bounded copy-offset trailers with byte, halfword, or word loads instead of a byte loop.
Use exact-size ARM64 copies and fills through 64 bytes; retain libc memcpy for larger literals and initialized-span doubling for overlaps.
Use macOS 11 deployment marker with baseline Apple Silicon instructions.

abi.snappyUncompress: int (const uint8_t *input, size_t length, SnappyBuffer *output, size_t maxOutput)

scope: General raw Snappy codec, arbitrary supported bytes, all copy tags, overlap, strict limits and truncation checks. Identical compressed bytes to the Nifty and Nim algorithm.
timing: Same C driver as Hand C; retained output buffers; paired compression plus decompression; input generation, checksums and byte comparisons untimed.

rejected_candidates.reason: Improved some mixed samples but regressed large random literals; keep libc for bulk copies.

rejected_candidates.change: Forward overlap expansion and short-period SIMD table expansion
rejected_candidates.reason: Slower than initialized-span doubling in rotated screening; preserve the simpler selected implementation.
